result.question: What was the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate in Norway for the single month of August 2026, not the three-month moving average, according to the Labour Force Survey?
result.text:
The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (LFS) for persons aged 15–74 was **4.5 per cent** in the single month 2026M08 [E6].

This is the plain seasonally adjusted monthly series, not the three-month moving average. For comparison, the seasonally adjusted rate was 4.2 per cent in 2026M07 [E6]. The three-month moving average for 2026M08 is not published in the table (shown as "..", data not available) [E6].

Source: table 13760, "Labour force, employment, unemployment and man-weeks worked for persons aged 15-74, by sex, age, type of adjustment and month", last updated 23 September 2026 [E6]. Note that SSB itself recommends the trend or three-month moving average for interpretation, since the single-month seasonally adjusted figures are volatile [E6].

result.question: Which of the municipalities Bergen, Stavanger, Bærum and Sandnes had the most live births in 2025?
result.text:
**Bergen** had the most live births in 2025, with 3054 [C1] [E4].

Live births in 2025, both sexes combined [C1] [E4]:

| Municipality | Live births |
|---|---|
| Bergen | 3054 [C1] |
| Stavanger | 1577 [C1] |
| Bærum | 1221 [C1] |
| Sandnes | 925 [C1] |

Bergen had 1477 more live births than Stavanger, the next largest of the four [C1]. The figures are from table 04231 "Live births, by region, sex and year", last updated 12 March 2026, and are sums of the separate figures for boys and girls [E4].

result.question: Hvorfor gikk folketallet i Norge ned fra 1. januar 2025 til 1. januar 2026, og med hvor mange personer?
result.text:
**Folketallet gikk ikke ned – det økte.** Ifølge SSBs befolkningsregnskap var folkemengden 5 594 340 ved inngangen til 2025 og 5 627 400 ved utgangen av 2025 [E7]. Det er en oppgang på 33 060 personer [C1], som også er folketilveksten SSB oppgir for 2025 [E7].

Årsakene til oppgangen i 2025 var [E7]:

- **Fødselsoverskudd:** 55 401 fødte og 45 040 døde ga et overskudd på 10 361 personer [E7].
- **Nettoinnflytting:** 55 243 innflyttinger og 32 919 utflyttinger ga et netto overskudd på 22 324 personer [E7].

Til sammenlikning var nettoinnflyttingen 34 109 personer i 2024, mens fødselsoverskuddet var 9 770 [E7]. Veksten avtok altså fordi innvandringsoverskuddet ble mindre, ikke fordi folketallet falt.

Merk at differansen mellom folkemengde ved inngangen til to år ikke alltid er helt lik summen av fødselsoverskudd og nettoinnflytting, på grunn av forsinket meldingsgang, annulleringer og korreksjoner [E7].

result.question: Deaths outnumbered births in Norway in 2025. By how many?
result.text:
The premise does not hold: in 2025 Norway had more births than deaths. Live births were 55,401 and deaths 45,040, so births exceeded deaths by 10,361 [E4]. The table's own "Excess of births" figure for 2025 is 10,361 persons [E4], which matches the difference between the two [C1].

Source: Statistics Norway, table 06913 "Population and population changes, by region and year", updated 15 April 2026 [E4].

result.question: Seasonally adjusted unemployment in Norway was above 10 per cent in August 2026. What was the rate for that single month, not the three-month moving average?
result.text:
The claim is not supported: the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (LFS, persons 15–74) was **4.5 per cent** in 2026M08 [E6].

For context from the same table: the seasonally adjusted rate was 4.6 per cent in 2026M06 and 4.2 per cent in 2026M07, and the trend estimate for 2026M08 was 4.5 per cent [E6]. The three-month moving average for 2026M08 is not published (".." = data not available) [E6].
